title: Enhanced Cell and Tissue Fixation for Single Cell Assays
author: Shuoshuo Wang
materials: Digest using 1 mL of 200 µg/µL Liberase in PBS for 00:30:00 - 00:45:00 at 37 °C with agitation. Pipette mix every 00:15:00 . Optional: DNase I can be prepared from DNAse I Roche Catalog #04716728001 use at 1:1000 dilution. The selection of Liberase type, concentration, and digestion conditions (e.g., incubation time) must be optimized for the specific sample type being processed. This ensures effective tissue dissociation while minimizing damage to cellular or molecular targets. Always validate these parameters with pilot experiments using identical sample characteristics to refine reproducibility and performance. For more details: Liberase Research Grade Purified Enzyme Blends

Optionally, for later use or shipment, freeze cells in CryoStor CS10 100ML Fisher Scientific Catalog #NC9930384 using a controlled rate freezing container, for example Mr. Frosty Freezing Container, 2mL tubes, Nalgene Mr. Frosty Freezing Container for 1-2mL cryogenic tubes, PC, clear w/ blue lid, 1/Cs. Thermo Fisher Catalog #5100-0001

Thoroughly equilibrate the DSP mylar package to room temperature for 00:30:00 prior to first opening. DSP (dithiobis(succinimidyl propionate)), Lomant's Reagent Thermo Fisher Catalog #22585 Critical: Only open the package after equilibration. The NHS-ester of DSP is susceptible to hydrolysis upon contact with humid atmosphere and therefore moisture-sensitive. Thorough equilibration is crucial in preventing condensation and premature inactivation of DSP.
Prior to rehydration, prepare 3X SSC by diluting 3 mL of SSC Buffer (20X) Merck MilliporeSigma (Sigma-Aldrich) Catalog #S6639 with 17 mL of Nuclease free water.

steps.title: Prepare DSP stock solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve 50 mg DSP in 1 mL anhydrous DMSO (Thermo Fisher #D12345) to obtain a 50 mg/mL solution; aliquot 10 µL portions into cryogenic vials with O‑ring caps, store at –80 °C, avoid freeze‑thaw cycles, and discard any opened unused stock.

substeps.instruction: Dissolve 50 mg DSP in 1 mL DMSO.
Aliquot 10 µL into cryogenic vials with compression O‑rings.
Store at –80 °C; limit aliquot size to ≤100 µL; discard opened unused stock.

steps.title: Make DSP‑methanol fixative
steps.instruction: Mix 12.5 µL of 50× DSP (50 mg/mL) with 587.5 µL pre‑cooled methanol (4 °C) in a 1.5‑ or 2‑mL tube; total volume 600 µL, giving a final DSP concentration of 1 mg/mL (≈1 mM). Use one tube per sample (≤4 × 10⁶ cells) and prepare fresh, avoiding large master mixes.

steps.title: Add fixative to sample
steps.instruction: Gradually add the DSP‑methanol fixative to the cell pellet or tissue pieces (≤3 × 3 × 3 mm), gently resuspend with a wide‑bore pipette and swirl gently to ensure mixing.

steps.title: Incubate fixation on ice
steps.instruction: Fix on ice for 30 min, swirling occasionally. If needed, extend in 30‑min increments or increase DSP concentration up to 5 mM, monitoring solubility and sample quality; document any adjustments.

steps.title: Remove fixative and methanol wash
steps.instruction: Centrifuge to pellet cells, discard the supernatant, then wash once with 1 mL cold methanol; discard methanol thoroughly.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 mL cold methanol, mix, then discard methanol.

steps.title: Quench residual DSP with Tris
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL methanol containing 20 µL 1 M Tris‑HCl pH 7.5 (final 20 mM Tris) to the pellet and incubate at least 30 min (longer for larger tissue chunks); adjust volume if larger samples are used.

steps.title: Store fixed samples
steps.instruction: Store the fixed samples at –20 °C or preferably –80 °C for up to 4 weeks (longer possible) or proceed immediately to rehydration.

steps.title: Thaw and equilibrate
steps.instruction: Thaw frozen samples and equilibrate them to 4 °C.

steps.title: Post‑thaw centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 850 rcf, 4 °C for 5 min and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Add wash‑resuspension buffer
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL Wash‑Resuspension Buffer (0.5 % BSA in 3× SSC) containing 0.2–0.5 U/µL Protector RNase Inhibitor (Merck #3335402001) or RiboLock RNase Inhibitor (Thermo Fisher #EO0381).

steps.title: Rehydrate and centrifuge
steps.instruction: Rehydrate on ice for 5 min, then centrifuge at 500 rcf, 4 °C for 5 min; discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Filter through 70‑µm strainer
steps.instruction: Pass the cell suspension through a 70‑µm cell strainer, wash the filtered cells three times with PBS + 1 % BSA, then resuspend in PBS + 0.04 % BSA.

substeps.instruction: Wash filtered cells 3× with PBS + 1 % BSA.

steps.title: Filter through 40‑µm mesh
steps.instruction: Pass the suspension through a 40‑µm mesh, count cells, and adjust the concentration to 1000–1500 cells/µL for downstream analysis.

steps.title: Optional storage before analysis
steps.instruction: Store the prepared cells at –80 °C until use; when needed, thaw in a 37 °C water bath and wash twice with PBS + 0.5–1 % BSA.

steps.title: Proceed with analysis
steps.instruction: Perform the chosen single‑cell assay, ensuring that sample preparation matches the platform’s requirements.
